Class SemanticElementEvidence

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.internal.locator.semantic.SemanticElementEvidence
public final class SemanticElementEvidence extends Object
Inspected accessibility / DOM evidence used to choose a locator (issue #5457 FR-3). Match counts come from inspection (live page, aria snapshot, or fixture) and are required for uniqueness enforcement (FR-2).
